# Proposed fix: handle recorded stage-07 fetch failures in stage 08

Diagnosis: glm_generate.py:37 unconditionally loads catalogue/<video_id>.json for every kept candidate. fetch_videos.py explicitly records failed_fetch_error and continues without that video. The sync report records CeQJepmYkjQ, bAqX-CGcOy4 and HxccuNyY2e8 as subtitle HTTP 429 failures; no catalogue files exist. Seven kept videos lack catalogue files, including a members-only video. A plain driver rerun skips stage 07 and repeats the same crash after paid model calls.

Proposed change to 00_GLOSSARY_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/glm_generate.py (not applied):
1. Before initializing the model client or making calls, load transcript_sync_report.json and index results by video_id. Preflight every selected video with kept concept pairs. If its catalogue is missing and its report outcome is not failed_fetch_error, raise a descriptive input-consistency error before any paid calls. Do not silently discard unexpected missing files or fabricate metadata.
2. Inside the video loop, after computing pairs and before video_prompt, if the catalogue is missing and the report records failed_fetch_error, append one rejection per concept and continue without a model call:

```python
r = sync_results.get(vid)
if not (BANK / 'catalogue' / f'{vid}.json').exists():
    # Preflight has already verified this is a recorded fetch failure.
    reason = f"Stage 07 failed_fetch_error; no cached metadata/transcript: {r['error_detail']}"
    rejected.extend({'video_id': vid, 'concept_id': cid, 'reason': reason}
                    for cid in pairs)
    print(f'{vid}: 0 proposals, {len(pairs)} rejected (stage 07 fetch failure)')
    continue
```

This follows fetch_videos.py's documented continue-without-video behavior and retains an explicit rejection for every affected concept. Preserve schema validation, evaluator checks, coverage gates and ledger accounting; downstream coverage deficiencies must still trigger normal replacement/repair, not a forced pass.

Tests: recorded missing-catalogue fetch failure yields exactly one rejection per concept and no model call; unexpected missing catalogue fails before all model calls; cached videos keep existing behavior; output passes the unchanged segment_proposals schema. Include all seven missing videos in the fixture.

After an authorized maintainer applies and tests the fix, rerun the stopped command for c1 and resume the driver to handle c2/c3 as well. Optionally recover public-video caches through the normal stage-07 fetch workflow after throttling subsides, with normal artifact/gate provenance handling; do not repeatedly rerun the unchanged driver or attempt to bypass members-only access. No code or pipeline artifacts were edited and no paid rerun was performed during this read-only triage.
